name: Carmen Crespo Díaz - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the future of agriculture and the post-2027 common agricultural policy
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants from the EU's farming policy after 2027. It asks for a bigger farm budget protected from inflation, kept separate from other EU funds, and paid mainly as direct income support to active farmers. It wants simpler rules, less paperwork, fairer prices for farmers, support for young and women farmers, and import rules that match EU standards. This is the Parliament's position only; it does not change any law yet.

- Parliament calls for a larger, inflation-proof farm budget kept separate from other EU funds.
- Farmers would face simpler rules, and imports would have to meet EU standards.
- The Commission decides whether to propose new farm laws; Parliament and governments would then negotiate them.
